raw:
Subject: power out in half the flat

Hi, half our apartment has no power since this evening. The RCD keeps tripping when we reset it. We have a baby, is there any chance someone can come tonight or first thing tomorrow? We're in Wittenbach. Thanks, Sandra
notes_for_testing: Urgent, emotional. No address detail, no phone. Tests urgency scoring AND the missing-field flag.

raw: hi its peter from the bakery on marktgasse. one of the ovens keeps cutting out. can u come look

raw: [Transcript, 2m14s] Caller: Yeah hello, I'm calling about — we've bought a place in Herisau and the inspection report flagged the whole board needs replacing, it's one of the old ones with the ceramic fuses. Reception: OK, and do you have the report? Caller: Yes I can email it. Reception: And when did you want this done? Caller: We take possession end of April so any time in May really. It's a three bedroom, built I think 1962. Reception: I'll get someone to call you back with a time to come look.
notes_for_testing: Herisau is canton Appenzell Ausserrhoden — tests service-area boundary logic. Attachment referenced but not present.
